title: Vitess: full cluster status (etcd topo + control + 2 vtgate + 2 shards x 3 tablets)
description: Runs `nexus status vitess` across all 12 nodes. One table rolls up the 3 etcd topo servers, the vtctld/VTOrc control node, the 2 vtgate routers, and the 6 tablets (Shard column, primary/replica per shard read from the topo).

observe.what: 12-row table: 3 etcd alive, control alive, 2 routers alive, shard -80 + 80- each 1 primary + 2 replica (Shard set); overall green
JSON ClusterStatus: 12 members, overallHealth=green, shardId set per tablet, etcd/control/router shardId=null

whatProves: VitessAdapter.GetStatusAsync classifies nodes by name (etcd/control/vtgate/tablet), reads tablet roles from GetTablets (topo), and maps the reported VMnet10 IP back to the vms.yaml node.
